title: Deck Icon Exploration
summary: Round 2 explores three compact line-icon alternatives for the Deck as a multi-faceted project console: project facets, a console frame, and a faceted project tile. Includes light and dark theme proofs, a recommendation, the rejected Round 1 direction, and the exact later implementation seam.
